MOVED TO EXTEND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE 2022-14. VICE CHAIR LOPEZ SECONDED THE MOTION. Council member White asked if the property owner will proceed with locating the two single family homes on the property if the rest of the project is not approved. Chair Nadolski stated he does not believe the developer will proceed if the property is not vacated. Council member Hyer stated that is a matter that could be addressed when additional information is presented by the applicant and Community and Economic Development staff. Chair Nadolski called for a vote on the motion to extend.
MOVED TO EXTEND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE 2022-18. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER BLAIR,
